title: Taunton man held without bail in murder of man found shot to death in Highland Street shed - NewsBreak
text: TAUNTON — More than a year after Johnny Lajoie was found shot to death in a furnished shed on Highland Street in Taunton , police have identified and charged a suspect with murder. Manny Pina, 26, of Taunton, was arraigned Wednesday, July 9, 2025, in Taunton District Court on charges of murder and unlawfully carrying a firearm. The murder of Lajoie is alleged to have taken place on May 4, 2024. Pina was ordered held without bail at his arraignment Wednesday. A police record related to the court case against Pina was impounded at the July 9 hearing, meaning that the Gazette and other media outlets do not currently have access to the police record. Pina's attorney, Louis Badwey, declined to comment on the case, as did the prosecutor, Bristol County Assistant District Attorney Jason Mohan. Alcohol at Taunton gaming center? What we know Lajoie, a Taunton resident who was 32 at the time, was found shot to death in a furnished shed at 155 Highland St. in Taunton on the morning of Saturday, May 4, 2024, the Bristol County District Attorney's Office said at the time. At around 9:45 a.m. on May 4, Taunton Police were dispatched to 155 Highland St. for a report of a dead man in a furnished shed, the DA's office said. Upon arrival, investigators determined the victim had been shot to death. Massachusetts State Police detectives assigned to the district attorney's office, Taunton Police and Homicide Unit prosecutors were "actively investigating a homicide which occurred sometime" Saturday morning on Highland Street, the DA's office said in a written statement on the afternoon of the shooting. Pina's next court date is on Aug. 18, 2025, for a probable cause hearing. This article originally appeared on The Taunton Daily Gazette: Taunton man held without bail in murder of man found shot to death in Highland Street shed
